integrity: Analytical proof of two-term exact-power asymptotics; finite numerical diagnostics do not establish infinite-dimensional asymptotics.
scientific_limitations: Two-term coefficients for exact positive power-law unilateral shifts and fixed admissible parameters only. No second-order claim for general regularly varying weights or weak-ideal novelty claim.
title: Two-term Schatten and operator-norm asymptotics for Aluthge iterates of power-law shifts
